note: Ability values per star level (1/2/3) for champions whose values are missing in the CommunityDragon export. Transcribed from text and a screenshot the owner pasted from a stats site (site not named) on 2026-10-21. Not used by the engine yet (combat is B6); kept so the values are not lost. Values are third-party until checked in game.

records.name: Haymaker
records.text: Passive: upon falling below 40% max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana. Active: wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for 225/275/2000 before dealing 222/355/5233 physical damage in a large cone.

records.name: Withering Curse
records.text: Passive: gain 25% Omnivamp. Active: fire a dark blast at 3 nearby enemies, dealing 60/90/500 magic damage and cursing them for 4 seconds; spawn a Hex withering zone for the same duration dealing 33/50/500 magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take 22/33/240 more damage per curse.

records.name: Firestorm
records.text: Charge up, gaining 15% Ability Power per Burning enemy. Then gain 250/350/3000 Shield for 2.5 seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing 80/120/1500 magic damage to each. After rushing, unleash a 2 Hex firestorm that deals a total of 475/715/5000 magic damage split among all enemies hit over 2 seconds.

records.name: Belchy Bubble
records.text: Adaptor (AP): bubble explodes on the first enemy hit for 225/340/535 magic damage; enemies within 1 hex take 175/265/410 magic damage over 3 seconds. Adaptor (AD): heavily slows the target. Purple Buff: every 5 seconds, gain 30% Ability Power.
records.note: Splash 175/265/410 matches the 18.3 notes (AP Form Ability DoT 160/240/360 => 175/265/410); the 18.4 B-patch line 'Gromp AP Form Splash Damage: 160/240/375 => 180/270/435' disagrees, kept as a conflict.

conflicts.note: 18.4 mid-patch update line; its old values (160/240/375) also differ from the 18.3 notes' new values

records.name: Taste Their Fear
records.text: Leap to the farthest enemy within 3 Hexes, dealing 265/370/535 magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal 285/410/605 magic damage instead and gain 10 mana.

records.name: Heat Without Equal
records.text: Passive: attacks deal 75/75/100% damage to enemies adjacent to the target. Active: become invulnerable and fly up; on return stun all enemies for 1.25/1.25/99 s, gain 15/15/100% Omnivamp and Ignite them for 3/3/99 s (2/2/20% max Health physical damage per second). Then cast Flame Breath: 305/465/7200 physical damage in a line, 20% less per enemy passed (minimum 20%), Ignite. Elder Dragon Buff: damaging an enemy below 12% Health executes it.

records.name: Furious Fists
records.text: Passive: on attack, restore 22/40/71 Health. Active: restore 200/265/360 Health, then gain 85/100/125% Attack Speed, 15% Durability and Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

records.name: Crimson Fury
records.text: Passive: when the target dies, leap at the next target for 155/235/1000 physical damage. Active: gain 80/80/300% Attack Damage for 8 s and ignore 45/45/90% Armor. Red Buff: attacks 1% Burn and heal 4% max Health.
records.note: Ability AD 80% and leap 155/235 match the 18.2 values; the 18.4 notes changed them (Ability Bonus AD 80% => 100%, Leap 155/235 => 135/205), so this page looks pre-18.4 for Brambleback.

records.name: Solar Judgement
records.text: Ascends by star level. 1st: attacks deal 62/92/105 bonus magic damage. 2nd: attacks 20% Shred for 2 s. 3rd: attacks fire waves for 35 magic damage to all other units hit. 4th: infinite range, every 3rd wave much larger.
records.note: 62/92/105 is the 18.2 value; the 18.4 notes say Kayle Ability Damage 62/92/105/115 => 65/97/110/115.

records.name: Rock and Roll
records.text: Passive: on death split into two Kruglettes (182/338/608 Health) that taunt. Active: gain 175/225/325 max Health, then roll into the target for 223/358/620 damage. Slate Buff: on death, Krug and Kruglettes shield allies for 8% max Health.

records.name: Can You Dig It?
records.text: Passive: attacks are replaced by a dance dealing 50/75/113 physical damage to all adjacent enemies. Active: burrow, 15% Durability for 3 s and heal 325/400/675 over the duration. Green Buff: allies below 50% Health restore 15% max Health.

records.name: Triggerseed
records.text: Passive: shields can crit with Precision. Active: give 2/2/10 allies 185/350/3000 Shield and 10/15/100% Damage Amp for 6 s, then deal 155/235/2000 magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After 6 casts, also grant 100% stacking Attack Speed.
